interpretation: Under Neutral Freight and wide Modeled priors, economic-negative customer-months remain a thin tail (median 125 ≈ 1.20× baseline 104; p95 255 ≈ 2.45× baseline). The distribution is right-skewed: negative counts rise faster than linearly as product-cost rate increases. Returns-pool ×2 changes the count only modestly (see returns_pool_stress).
